description: Widget Menu Extender: adds custom names and custom default values to the context menus of modules from other makers

params.text: Bright blue, the added menu options appear on other makers' knobs and ports; dark, they do not, and names and defaults already set stay. Bright red means another instance is already active

notes: one instance can be active per patch, and the custom names and defaults it holds are saved with the patch and are given up when the module is removed from it
it adds nothing to its own menu; the extra items appear on the knobs and ports of other makers' modules while the button is lit blue
menu: Parameter name, on another maker's knob — a text field renaming that knob, with Restore factory name beneath it once a new name is set
Set default to current value, on another maker's knob — makes the present position the value a double-click returns to, with Restore factory default beneath it once set
Port name, on another maker's port — a text field renaming that jack, with Restore factory name beneath it once a new name is set
